_scope: Phase 1 font-outline estimates only; no trajectory generation and no default profile replacement.

aspect_ratio_target.notes: Target aspect from static font outline; not a complete structure model.

horizontal_scale_hint.notes: Derived as sqrt(style_font_aspect / kaishu_font_aspect); aspect alone cannot uniquely determine X/Y scales.

vertical_scale_hint.notes: Paired inverse of horizontal_scale_hint; use only as a readonly candidate.

base_width_hint.notes: Mean stroke width from font distance transform; needs visual normalization before use.

stroke_width_distribution.notes: Readonly style width distribution hint; not an execution taper model.

projection_summary.method: summary spread only, not full distribution
projection_summary.notes: Only spread hints are available in current font_style_gap_summary.csv.
